name: Supplier performance scorecard
summary: Once a quarter, the buyer or operations lead scores each key supplier from the business's own order and receiving exports: on-time delivery, fill rate, defects and returns, price against agreed terms and order confirmations, with the trend, the evidence behind every score and the points to raise. A person decides.

sources.title: Stated export headers with a stop when one does not match, price against the business's own agreed-price list with the amount above it, a minimum number of lines before a measure is judged, every miss listed as evidence, the comparison with last quarter with a band for level, targets met counted instead of a blended score, points to raise, trigger-based decision questions, and the rule that nothing is sent and no tier or record is changed, written for this template.

sources.contribution: A supplier review every quarter; punctuality, completeness and damage worked out from order and receiving records, each with a target; deliveries in parts followed line by line; order confirmations tracked; the gap between an order's due date and the day stock was truly wanted; and the figures taken to the supplier.

Whether the business could manage without a supplier kept apart from the size of the bill, so an irreplaceable supplier with a small bill still gets full attention; a figure slipping quarter on quarter raised before it crosses its target; and leaving a supplier kept off the table until a replacement is ready.
